S1SIG.ConnEstabAtt.doc: UE-associated logical S1 connection attempts eNB->MME

ERAB.EstabInitAttNbr.sum.doc: Initial E-RABs requested (INITIAL CONTEXT SETUP REQUEST)

ERAB.EstabInitSuccNbr.sum.doc: Initial E-RABs established (INITIAL CONTEXT SETUP RESPONSE)

ERAB.RelActNbr.sum.doc: E-RABs released while active (data in buffer), excluding normal/mobility causes

ERAB.SessionTimeUE.doc: Aggregated in-session seconds for UEs in the cell

HO.ExeAtt.doc: Outgoing handover executions attempted, all types

DRB.IPVolDl.sum.doc: kbits of scheduled IP throughput volume, DL (last TTI excluded per TS 36.314)

DRB.IPTimeDl.sum.doc: Time duration of scheduled IP throughput, DL

DRB.IPVolUl.sum.doc: kbits of scheduled IP throughput volume, UL

DRB.IPTimeUl.sum.doc: Time duration of scheduled IP throughput, UL

RRU.PrbTotDl.doc: Mean DL total PRB usage 0-100 over the granularity period; aggregate time-weighted, never summed

RRU.CellUnavailableTime.sum.doc: Seconds the cell was unavailable in the granularity period

erab_accessibility.name: E-RAB Accessibility (A1, initial E-RAB)
erab_accessibility.clause: TS 32.450 6.1.1.1, A1 = RRC SR x S1 SR x initial E-RAB SR

erab_drop_ratio.name: E-RAB drop ratio (active releases / all releases)
erab_drop_ratio.note: Widely used as 'service drop rate' but not defined in TS 32.450, which defines retainability per session time (R2).

ho_exec_sr.name: Handover execution success rate
ho_exec_sr.clause: TS 32.450 6.5.1.1 execution part, HO.ExeSucc / HO.ExeAtt (intra- and inter-eNB, intra- and inter-frequency)

ip_thp_dl.name: E-UTRAN IP throughput DL
ip_thp_dl.clause: TS 32.450 6.3.1, IP Throughput DL = sum ThpVolDl / sum ThpTimeDl; TS 32.425 4.4.6.3 and 4.4.6.5

prb_util_dl.name: DL total PRB usage (time-weighted)
prb_util_dl.note: TS 32.425 4.5.3 gives RRU.PrbTotDl as a percentage per period; it is not a 32.450 KPI. Aggregated as a time-weighted mean, never as a sum of percentages.

RRC.ConnEstabAtt.sum.note: Common Ericsson KPIs subtract pmRrcConnEstabAttReatt (re-attempts); 3GPP TS 32.450 does not, so neither does the model.

ERAB.SessionTimeUE.note: Unit assumed seconds, as in TS 32.425 4.2.4.1; confirm for your release.

HO.ExeAtt.note: EUtranCellRelation counters summed to the source cell before export.

RRU.PrbTotDl.note: pmPrbAvailDl is public; 'PRB used DL' is a sum of several pmPrbUsedDl* counters that varies by release. The synthetic export carries it pre-summed as pmPrbUsedDl.

RRC.ConnEstabAtt.sum.note: Also exported per cause (.Emc, .HighPri, .Mt, .MoData, .MoSig, .DelayTol); the total is used.

ERAB.EstabInitAttNbr.sum.note: Counts initial and added E-RABs together; there is no separate initial-only counter in this mapping.

ERAB.SessionTimeUE.note: No public Huawei equivalent identified; R2 retainability is reported as unavailable for Huawei rather than estimated.

HO.ExeAtt.note: Intra/inter-eNB x intra/inter-frequency executions; inter-RAT handovers are not included.

RRU.CellUnavailableTime.sum.note: L.Cell.Unavail.Dur.Sys is public; confirm the name of the manual-unavailability counter.

RRC.ConnEstabAtt.sum.note: SIGN_CONN_ESTAB_ATT per cause (MO signalling, MT, MO data, emergency, high priority, delay tolerant); the set of causes varies by release.

ERAB.EstabInitAttNbr.sum.note: EPS_BEARER_SETUP_ATTEMPTS: initial and added E-RABs together, like the Huawei mapping.

unavailable_counters.note: No public Huawei equivalent identified; R2 retainability is reported as unavailable for Huawei rather than estimated.
